description: Changes the person's portfolio: publish or hide it, a display name (shown as chosen by its holder, not checked; null clears it), a home site that says who is behind it (one of their sites proved by DNS or a file), or whether one site is named on it or goes by its code. A site is named only where its own owner lets it be. Answers the portfolio as mttr_portfolio does.

home.description: One of the person's sites proved by DNS or a file, as a domain.

name.description: A display name, at most 40 characters.

publish.description: True to publish, false to hide.

shown.description: named, or code for its code on the profile. Give it with site.

site.description: A site in the portfolio, to set how it is shown.

name: mttr_portfolio_set
title: Set the portfolio
